# Twirl

Twists the image around a point like a whirlpool: strongest at the center and fading out by the edge of the radius.

<EffectDemo effect="twirl" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { twirl } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/twirl';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(twirl({ preset: 'whirlpool' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.center = [0.5, 0.5]`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type   | Default      | Range        | Description                                            |
| --------- | ------ | ------------ | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `center`  | [x, y] | `[0.5, 0.5]` | 0 – 1        | Center of the twirl, in UV coordinates.                |
| `radius`  | number | `0.4`        | 0.05 – 1.5   | Reach of the twirl, as a fraction of the frame height. |
| `angle`   | number | `120`        | -720 – 720 ° | Rotation at the center; negative twirls the other way. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                    |
| ----------- | --------------------------- |
| `whirlpool` | `angle: 360`, `radius: 0.5` |
| `gentle`    | `angle: 45`                 |
| `counter`   | `angle: -180`               |
| `wide`      | `radius: 1.2`, `angle: 200` |

Apply one with `twirl({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Distortion & warp · tracked as story X9.5 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 5.4 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/twirl`, including the shared effect runtime.
